parts.why: A page that points at a moved or deleted page sends an agent to nothing.
A page nobody has reviewed in months is trusted as if it were current.
The index and the contract send agents to code names; a renamed class must not leave them pointing at nothing.
parts.heading: Search aliases

parts.why: A playbook stays only while a recorded eval run shows it working, so it cannot change without one.
Staging everything sweeps another session's edits into a commit; the reminder comes before the commit refuses it.
A commit holds only the files the agent session wrote, so another session's edits stay out of it.
src/orders-service-v1 looks current and is kept read-only for audits; an edit there fixes nothing that runs.
Nothing private reaches this public repository, in a file, a file name, a commit message or an identity.
Every delegated task names its tier and runs at that tier's model and effort, as the orchestration rules require.
